lessons.title: Practice Pointers References in C
lessons.description: Finish swapValues so the two integers trade places through their references. Save the first value in a temporary variable before you overwrite it. After swapValues(x, y) with x equal to 10 and y equal to 20, x is 20 and y is 10. The test checks that x equals 20 || y != 10.

tests.name: test_swap_ref

source.name: cppreference.com — Pointer and member pointer types — address-of and indirection

learning_objectives: Cove pickers recount crates before dawn, and swap two integers through references without losing a value.

exercises.question: Cove pickers recount crates before dawn. For swap two integers through references without losing a value, which line reads the integer through a pointer?
